diagnosis.summary: The product-service Lambda handler is running roughly 447 times slower than baseline, pushing all end-to-end latency percentiles above 1.4 seconds against a sub-10 ms normal. Payment-service shows no degradation. No 5xx errors are present on either service.
diagnosis.root_cause: Severe slowdown of the product-service Lambda handler body is the most likely root cause, with handler CPU time rising from 2.5 ms to 1,110.6 ms mean and end-to-end latency tracking that increase almost exactly.
evidence: product-service lambda_duration_ms_mean rose from 2.486 ms to 1,110.6 ms, a 447x increase, and lambda_duration_ms_p95 rose from 3.12 ms to 1,256.9 ms, a 403x increase.

product-service p50_latency_ms rose from 4.09 ms to 1,475.1 ms (361x), p95_latency_ms from 6.56 ms to 1,486.4 ms (227x), and p99_latency_ms from 9.59 ms to 1,521.9 ms (159x), tracking the handler duration increase closely across all percentiles.
payment-service lambda_duration_ms_mean is 0.3077 ms against a baseline of 0.5855 ms, and p95_latency_ms is 3.60 ms against a baseline of 4.51 ms, showing no degradation.
error_rate_5xx is 0 on both product-service and payment-service, unchanged from baseline.
payment-service request_rate is 2.0 rps against a baseline of 0.9433 rps; product-service latency metrics show the slowdown regardless of this difference in traffic level.
recommended_actions: Inspect CloudWatch Logs for /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-product for slow code paths, errors, or unusual execution patterns in the current window starting 2026-11-15T13:59:00Z.

Check the CloudWatch Errors metric for anomalypulse-product to determine whether any invocations are hitting the 10-second timeout, since those would not appear in error_rate_5xx or the latency percentiles.
Review any recent changes to the anomalypulse-product function code, layers, or configuration that could account for a handler slowdown of this magnitude.
After identifying the slow code path in the logs, fix or roll back only if logs confirm the change touched that path, then recheck lambda_duration_ms_mean and p95_latency_ms to confirm recovery.
